title: Largest Number At Least Twice of Others
goal: Find the index of a maximum that is at least twice every other number, or return -1.
strategy: The second largest is the strongest competitor. Retain its value and the original index of the largest.

phasePurposes.inspect: The second largest is the strongest competitor. Retain its value and the original index of the largest.
phasePurposes.update: It is enough to compare the largest value with twice the second largest.
phasePurposes.done: It is enough to compare the largest value with twice the second largest.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
